power.name: MAX
power.note: Press B+C with at least 1 power stock to activate MAX mode (consumes 1 stock). Quick MAX: press B+C during a normal attack, command move or Body Blow (C+D) to activate MAX instantly mid-combo; costs 2 stocks. In MAX mode specials marked cancelable can be cancelled into other specials (MAX cancel), SDMs (MAX DMs) cost 1 stock, and HSDMs (MAX2) need MAX mode + 1 stock + low life (Dream Cancel: 1/4 life or less; SNK wiki: last 30%, when the life bar turns orange). Power gauge max level: 3 for 1st character, 4 for 2nd, 5 for 3rd. Sources: command.dat kof2002 entry; Dream Cancel wiki; SNK wiki MAX2 page.

sources: User-verified HSDM button sequences (GameFAQs: Jin_Sakazaki's KOF 2002 HSDM FAQ, A_Large_Trout's KOF 2002 Move List; Dream Cancel; SuperCombo)
